description: Extend the existing image preview functionality to support PDF file previews using native browser embedding. Additionally, enhance file handling in collection rows to allow users to open non-previewable files with a single click. The PDF preview should only be enabled when the UI is served from the same host as the backend due to current CSP restrictions.
functional_requirements: Adapt the existing preview panel component to embed PDF files using the native <object> HTML element
Maintain the same user interface and interaction patterns as the image preview feature
Implement logic to conditionally enable PDF preview only when the UI and backend share the same host origin
Add click-to-open functionality for non-previewable file types in collection rows
Ensure the solution reuses existing preview infrastructure while adding PDF-specific handling
